name: Aidín

attributes.attribute: a warrior of the elite Fianna

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aidín, also called Aideen, was a minor figure in Irish lore. She was the wife of Oscar, a warrior of the elite Fianna. She died of grief at the death of her husband. The bard Oisín buried her with high honors under a cairn on the hill called Benn Étair.

okr.objective: Record Aidín, the wife of the warrior Oscar.
key_results: Show her grief and her burial by the bard Oisín.
